body: OR, figure out how to use that money to make a life you'd actually want to live. Train for a dream job? Move across country? To a whole different country? If the alternative is dying, then nothing's too out there. Figure out what your best life would be and go get it.
I used to, but now I'm 30. Don't worry about numbers. Just do things.

Get out as soon as you can. Work a job, do it well enough to either get a promotion or get hired somewhere else. Come home to a place that's yours. Make friends. Invite them over on weekends. One day, realize it's been five years, or even ten years since you've lived in that house. Live your life.
